task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(2.577)|0> and RY(1.288)|0>. Compare the estimate from 16384 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((2.577-1.288)/2). Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
